name: New England Precision Inc.
old_description: New England Precision, Inc. is a precision metal stamping company specializing in brass and copper metal stampings. It was founded in 1988 and is an 80,000 square foot manufacturing and tooling facility offering the most experienced teams of professional personnel with the latest in tool, computer and metal stamping technology.
about:
Founded in 1988 in Randolph, Vermont, New England Precision Inc. operates an 80,000-square-foot manufacturing and tooling facility. The company began as a precision metal stamping specialist focused on brass and copper components.

Today the shop stamps a range of metals including brass, copper, aluminum, nickel, steel, and stainless steel. Its press line spans 18 to 280 tons with combined speed ranges, and the company maintains all tooling in-house to protect tool life and reduce costs. The facility houses both stamping and tool-and-die operations under one roof.

The company serves customers in building fire protection and hardware, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, and electrical sensors and controls. Its parts go into lock hardware, medical sensors, automotive controls, and aerospace components.

New England Precision emphasizes defect prevention and was an early adopter of ISO 9001 and the automotive IATF 16949 standard. Management describes its approach as versatility and flexibility, aiming to exceed expectations on every shipment while holding prices steady.
